summary: This bill requires each Executive agency to relocate at least 30 percent of its headquarters employees from the Washington metropolitan area to other regions within one year, ensuring their pay is based on the new locality and they cannot telework full-time, while also mandating a 30 percent reduction in agency headquarters office space.

scores.thoughts: This bill mandates the relocation of a significant portion of federal employees from the Washington metropolitan area and requires a reduction in headquarters office space. While the bill does not explicitly detail cost savings, reducing office space and potentially lowering salary costs by moving employees to areas with lower pay localities would likely lead to decreased government spending. The bill also prohibits relocation incentives, further suggesting a focus on cost reduction.
